message:
# Task List

1. ⏳ Dataset creation - Raw Triplets
Read root file, generate all possible triplets, calculate features, and save to triplets_raw.parquet.
2. ⏳ Dataset preparation - Splitting
Split data into train, val, and test sets. Handle class imbalance if needed.
3. ⏳ Model Training - XGBoost
Train XGBoost classifier, optimize hyperparameters, and save model and training report.
4. ⏳ Inference - Test Set
Run inference on test set and save results and report.
5. ⏳ Triplet Selection and Optimization
Implement event-level selection (max 2 top, disjoint jets), optimize threshold and strategy.
6. ⏳ Validation and Plots
Generate kinematic plots and mass sanity check.
7. ⏳ Final Reporting
Summarize findings and save optimization report.
